dedupe_keys.name: miviot review of urbanisation plans in the construction stage 2024 panama

description: Ministerio de Vivienda y Ordenamiento Territorial de Panamá (MIVIOT) publishes monthly counts of requests attended nationwide for the review of plans of urbanisation projects in the construction stage, broken down by political division down to corregimiento, released as 18 sets of CSV, XLSX and PDF files on one dataset page (the resource names are identical, so the period of each set was not confirmed). Coverage: Panama, by district and corregimiento, for 2024 according to the dataset title; the portal record was last modified on 2025-10-08, and a sibling record covers the earlier period (2022-2023). Format and access: PDF, XLSX, CSV, XLS, downloadable without registration from the Panama national open data portal; the portal also serves the metadata through a public API. Licence (read on the portal page on 2026-09-29): Creative Commons CCZero; cost: free. Caveats: the data count administrative requests, not buildings or lots, so they are a proxy for development activity; the files were not opened, so the exact columns and the completeness of each month are unconfirmed; the page carries 54 resources in 18 sets. Simulation uses: urban growth and housing-supply indicators by corregimiento, demand forecasts for utilities and services, and development-pressure inputs to exposure and land-use models. Related catalogue records: Panama national open data catalogue (data-panama-national-open-data-catalogue).
